item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
cases=(
  "--help"
  "--a http://example.com/path?x=1#frag --b foo.com"
  "--a=https://user:pass@example.com:8080/a/b?x=1&y=2#frag --b=bar.net"
  "--a=//example.com/path --b=bar.net"
  "--a=mailto:user@example.com?x=1#frag --b=foo"
  "--a=relative/path?x=1 --b="
  "--a= --b foo"
  "--a --b foo"
  "--a http://example.com --b foo --extra bar"
  "-hfoo"
)
for case in "${cases[@]}"; do
  py_out=$(mktemp)
  js_out=$(mktemp)
  py_code=0
  js_code=0
  /workspace/dataset/test2_executable $case >"$py_out" 2>&1 || py_code=$?
  node /output/test2.mjs $case >"$js_out" 2>&1 || js_code=$?
  sed -i "s/test2_executable/PROG/g; s/test2'"\\.mjs/PROG/g\" \""'$py_out" "$js_out"
  if [ "$py_code" -ne "$js_code" ] || ! cmp -s "$py_out" "$js_out"; then
    echo "FAIL: $case"
    echo "python($py_code):"
    cat "$py_out"
    echo "node($js_code):"
    cat "$js_out"
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo OK'
